Closes #198

@sepo-agent /answer 

can we further simplify it? the agent itself should determine whether it's a resolve vs minimize. So no need to have an environment variable.

Yes, I agree. We can simplify #199 by removing `AGENT_INLINE_COMMENT_CLEANUP_MODE` entirely and making this a synthesis-agent judgment.

The existing flow already supports that shape: reviewer lanes only suggest actions, and `review-synthesize.md` is the only place that re-fetches current inline comments/threads and mutates GitHub. So the decision can live there:

1. Resolve an existing same-agent review thread when it is unresolved, `viewerCanResolve`, belongs to the PR, all thread comments are same-agent, and the issue is addressed/superseded.
2. Minimize an older same-agent inline comment as `OUTDATED` when it is superseded but there is no appropriate resolvable review thread path.
3. Do nothing when authorship, PR ownership, supersession, or resolution confidence is uncertain.

Implementation plan for a follow-up on this PR:

- Remove `AGENT_INLINE_COMMENT_CLEANUP_MODE` from `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml`, `.agent/src/run.ts`, and `.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md`.
- Update `.github/prompts/review.md` so suggestions can include both `resolve_existing_thread` and `mark_existing_outdated` without mode gates.
- Update `.github/prompts/review-synthesize.md` to encode the decision policy above directly.
- Update `.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md` to describe agent-decided inline cleanup, not configurable cleanup mode.
- Adjust `.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts` to assert the new prompt contract and absence of the env var wiring.

That keeps the useful dual behavior, removes repo-level configuration surface, and matches the current prompt-managed architecture.
